newsitem.title: USA: AMRE Inc says completes 1.6 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: AMRE Inc says completes 1.6 mln shr offer.

text.p: AMRE Inc said on Friday it completed a 1.6 million share public offering of its common stock at $16 per share.

Proceeds from the sale would be used for working capital and general corporate purposes, including expansion of the company's CENTURY 21 Home Improvements Network field marketing system, AMRE said in a statement.
The company said 521,250 shares were sold for the accounts of two former executives of Facelifters Home Systems Inc FIX.A and the other 1.1 million shares were newly issued.
Feshbach Brothers Investors Services acted as financial advisor, AMRE said.
